WITH country_counts AS (
    SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM player_college AS pc
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id
    GROUP BY p.birth_country
), country_shares AS (
    SELECT birth_country, player_count,
           CAST(player_count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS player_share
    FROM country_counts
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(player_count) AS average_player_count
    FROM country_counts
)
SELECT SUM(cs.player_count) AS total_player_count,
       AVG(cs.player_share) AS average_share,
       AVG(cs.player_count - oa.average_player_count) AS average_excess_over_average
FROM country_shares AS cs
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE cs.player_count > oa.average_player_count;
